experience_now.shown_evidence: Obviously, if the science of AI consciousness is far from settled, it makes no sense to declare by fiat that AI is not conscious.

possible.shown_evidence: We barely understand consciousness, sentience, and agency in humans—barring unexpected breakthroughs, it’s hard to imagine that we’ll understand it before it arrives (if it does).

moral_status.shown_evidence: And if AI might be conscious, categorically rejecting the idea that it might deserve welfare is abominable.

serious.shown_evidence: Here, even more than in other parts of AI, I don’t really see a viable alternative to just trying to figure it out as we go.
